name: parnaioca-ia
description: API da Pousada Parnaioca para o curso de Agentes de IA com JavaScript

scripts.guia: node --input-type=module -e 'import { createServer } from "node:http"; import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises"; const server = createServer(async (req, res) => { if (!["GET", "HEAD"].includes(req.method)) { res.writeHead(405, { Allow: "GET, HEAD" }); res.end(); return; } if (!["/", "/guia-aluno.html"].includes(req.url.split("?")[0])) { res.writeHead(404); res.end("Nao encontrado"); return; } try { const html = await readFile("guia-aluno.html"); res.writeHead(200, { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store" }); res.end(req.method === "HEAD" ? undefined : html); } catch { res.writeHead(500); res.end("Nao foi possivel ler guia-aluno.html"); } }); server.on("error", error => { console.error(error.message); process.exitCode = 1; }); server.listen(8002, "127.0.0.1", () => console.log("Guia do aluno: http://127.0.0.1:8002 (Ctrl+C para encerrar)"));'

author: Vitor Esteves
